_comment: Retired tickers and what they became. Populated when scripts/watchlist.py check finds a symbol with no data and the cause is confirmed. successor null means the security ceased to exist (cash acquisition, or never a valid US listing). Dates are the first session the old symbol stopped trading.

CHK.reason: Merged with Southwestern Energy; renamed Expand Energy Corporation

SQ.reason: Block, Inc. ticker change from SQ to XYZ; NYSE listing unchanged

ITCI.reason: Acquired by Johnson & Johnson for $132.00/share cash; delisted from Nasdaq

DM.reason: Desktop Metal acquired by Nano Dimension for cash at $5.295/share; delisted from NYSE

CYBN.reason: Cybin rebranded Helus Pharma; US listing moved from NYSE American to Nasdaq

MNMD.reason: Mind Medicine rebranded Definium Therapeutics; Nasdaq listing unchanged

CIVI.reason: Civitas Resources merged into SM Energy; 1.45 SM shares per CIVI share

BRKB.reason: Not a valid symbol - a formatting error rather than a corporate action. Berkshire Hathaway class B is BRK-B on yfinance; BRKB returns no data

TGTG.reason: Never a valid US listing. Too Good To Go is private; the only TGTG is 11 88 0 Solutions AG on Xetra, which needs a .DE suffix in yfinance
